content.value: By writing one command and using the colon to address range of elements (do not type individual elements explicitly), use the matrix A to:
(i) Create a six-element row vector named ha that contains the elements of the second row of A.
(ii) Create a three-element column vector named hb that contains the elements of the sixth column of A.
(ii) Create a five-element row vector named hc that contains the first two elements of the third row of A and the last three element of the first row of A.
